correctness.rationale: For all integer d>=3 and squared cutoffs 1/2<=t<1, signed-permutation character decomposition gives complete invariant harmonic sectors of dimensions d, d(d-2), and binom(d,3). The normalized Dirichlet moment sum-of-squares formulas yield explicit incomplete-Beta eigenvalue integrals; direct symbolic Beta-tail derivative identities give both exact factorized gap formulas. The gap sign and a quadratic with unique positive root prove the exceptional d=3 crossover. A direct positive-sector A-C calculation handles the d=3 minimum. Fixed-d thin-cap asymptotics follow from endpoint Beta integration. The packaged checker independently reconstructs three conditional sector kernels and symbolically verifies identities with parameter d, then tests 25 high precision quadratures. Numerical tests are corroborative, not infinite proof; all endpoint exclusions and normalization appear in the proof.
